soul_corrections.current_text: The Bearzooka is drawn as a green, hazard-striped tube [Observed; Inference].
soul_corrections.correction: The BBG Bearzooka is a coral-red tube (#A54447; #D05655 under 2026 trailer lighting) with glowing orange chevron windows (#EB7921-#FF8F25), grey bands, a black bore and a grey-and-red checkered flared end, carried on the right shoulder [Observed]. Green launchers are Tillman's Twin Bearzookas (olive #868F43) or the BBZ/BB-1 Bearzooka [Observed; Fan-wiki].
soul_corrections.evidence: Wiki 2013 screenshot Photo_19-04-13_12_02_26_PM.png; Bearzooka_Concept.png; Steam trailer t_0009 (4.0 s): a green-skinned Soldier carries the coral launcher and wears a gold-and-black bullet bandolier, which is the source of the 'green' and the 'hazard stripes'; Ohmagawdyas.png (Twin Bearzookas); wiki Bearzooka page: 'In BBG and BB0, it is a rocket launcher with red and orange lines.'

soul_corrections.correction: Bind Gun #0991D4 (lit #1CB5F3, highlight #6CCFF4; reads about #367494 in dim in-game light), glowing white-cyan round muzzle #EBF0F5 [Observed, sampled].
